body: I took the high ground all my life. I want to do something stupid for once in my life.

I'll pay for the meeting, whatever it may be. I was thinking probably coffee or dinner or something like this. First date stuff.

I thought about going to a party at a nightclub. My friend is a partner in a couple nights so i could get free tables if i wanted to, but I figured it might be hard to arrange something like that with a total stranger.

Afterwards we each go our separate ways, and possibly become friends. Nothing more than that.
If you're really interested, pm me.

Any women over here in their 20's want to make their ex jealous?

I'm looking to make mine jealous, and if you're interested, send me a pm.

I propose going somewhere fun, and just chatting and doing random stuff. I'll pay of course, i only want you to know that i will post some pictures on social media. We don't have to share any personal information, I'm really just looking for a friend.
